notes: EPOCH in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer disease and APECS in prodromal Alzheimer disease were separate terminated phase 3 trials of the BACE1 inhibitor verubecestat. EPOCH was stopped for futility without slowing cognitive or functional decline; APECS was stopped for futility without benefit on its CDR-SB primary clinical outcome. Neither registry termination status alone establishes the reason.

Gamma-secretase-directed development; primary protein assignment unresolved. Experimental work found pseudo-inhibition distinct from presenilin loss of function; do not interpret the trial outcome as a PSEN1-specific target failure. One representative trial linked.

The initial NCT04032171 protocol ended in 2020 to change the active comparator; it was not an efficacy failure. The subsequent evolutionRMS 1 and 2 phase 3 trials failed to show superiority to teriflunomide on annualized relapse rate and were terminated after primary analysis.
Pilot seed; one representative trial linked

Primary protein target is unclear. Iniparib was historically described as a PARP inhibitor but experimental studies found no bona fide PARP inhibition and nonspecific modification of many cysteine-containing proteins. The negative trial outcome must not be interpreted as failure of PARP1 inhibition.

HSP90 inhibitor with alpha and beta isoform engagement; no unique primary isoform assigned. NCT00773344 studied tanespimycin with trastuzumab; the formerly linked NCT00627627 studied retaspimycin and was removed. No tanespimycin failure conclusion is supported by this registry record.
Promoted pilot batch; verify all program-level evidence before publication.
Promoted pilot batch; verify all program-level evidence before publication.

The JAMA report of STARSHINE STARBEAM and STARBRIGHT found no significant cognitive benefit on the prespecified ADAS-Cog primary endpoint in any of the three completed phase 3 trials. Target identity was corrected to the reviewed human HTR6 UniProt accession P50406; Q9Y5N1 belongs to HRH3 and must not be used for this drug.

TRINOVA-1 met its primary PFS endpoint; TRINOVA-2 and TRINOVA-3 did not improve their primary PFS endpoints. Later registry termination of long-term follow-up in TRINOVA-2/3 is separate from those efficacy findings. NCT00467025 was removed from this ovarian program because it is a phase 2 renal-cell-carcinoma study. Trebananib directly engages both ANGPT1 and ANGPT2; neither is designated the unique primary protein target. Broader program disposition remains under review.

The adenosine A1 receptor antagonist was evaluated in the paired PROTECT-1 and PROTECT-2 phase 3 protocols. The combined primary publication found no significant benefit on the prespecified three-category clinical outcome versus placebo. Both registry protocols completed; safety findings are not substituted for the primary efficacy result.

The monovalent anti-MET antibody was combined with erlotinib in the completed METLung phase 3 trial after prior platinum chemotherapy. The primary overall-survival endpoint was not improved versus placebo plus erlotinib; median OS was numerically shorter in the onartuzumab arm. The row previously misclassified this antibody as a small molecule.

DLL3-directed antibody-drug conjugate. MERU maintenance therapy was terminated after overall-survival futility in DLL3-high disease; TAHOE second-line therapy completed with inferior overall survival versus topotecan. Trial outcomes are distinct and should not be collapsed into a generic stop reason.
Promoted pilot batch; verify all program-level evidence before publication.

The published BRISK-PS negative overall-survival result belongs to completed NCT00825955. NCT01108705 was a distinct Asia-Pacific phase 3 study marked terminated in the registry without a stated why-stopped reason; it must not inherit the BRISK-PS endpoint result. Bristol Myers Squibb reported termination of the broader brivanib program during 2012 but did not attribute this protocol's stop to a specific endpoint or decision. Brivanib inhibits VEGFR and FGFR proteins without a unique primary protein assignment. The separate renal-cell-carcinoma NCT01253668 protocol is not part of this indication-level program.

NCT01253668 enrolled 10 participants and was terminated after the manufacturer decided not to pursue additional research in this patient population. Its posted outcome data were unavailable after the principal investigator left the institution; no failed efficacy endpoint is established. This is distinct from brivanib's HCC trials.

The randomized phase 3 NCT01009593 trial failed its prespecified overall-survival superiority and noninferiority criteria versus sorafenib. Time to progression and response rate favored linifanib while adverse events were more frequent. The registry says an independent monitoring committee recommended stopping but does not state a more specific stopping rationale. Linifanib inhibits VEGF and PDGF receptor families; no single primary receptor is assigned and the clinical result is not a single-protein target failure.

NCT00360867 was a safety-focused extension for patients coming from other motesanib protocols; it was not a randomized efficacy trial. The registry reports termination by Amgen decision without a specific efficacy or safety cause for this extension. This record must not inherit MONET1's NSCLC outcome. Motesanib inhibits several receptor kinases without one clinically established primary protein.

MONET1/NCT00460317 first enrolled squamous and nonsquamous NSCLC. Treatment and enrollment in the squamous cohort stopped after excess early deaths and fatal bleeding with motesanib. The amended nonsquamous comparison did not significantly improve overall survival versus chemotherapy alone despite favorable PFS and response-rate signals. The registry says Amgen discontinued development because MONET1 missed its primary objective. These regimen- and histology-specific findings are not failures attributable to one VEGFR or other protein.

NCT01799889 included several lymphoma and CLL cohorts. Gilead's registry states the trial ended after its decision to discontinue entospletinib development; this is not a demonstrated efficacy-endpoint failure. Published CLL subcohorts reported responses. Cohort-specific outcomes and later development under other sponsors require separate review.

indication_name: newly diagnosed NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia
notes: AGILITY/NCT05020665 tested entospletinib plus intensive chemotherapy. Kronos Bio stopped enrollment before the planned sample was reached because recruiting fit patients with NPM1-mutated AML was difficult and post-COVID constraints persisted. The registry and sponsor do not attribute the stop to a failed efficacy endpoint; this is separate from Gilead's earlier relapsed-hematology phase 2 program.

EGFR-directed antibody-drug conjugate. INTELLANCE-1/NCT02573324 was a completed phase 3 survival trial that stopped treatment early after an interim overall-survival futility finding. UNITE/NCT03419403 was a separate phase 3b ocular-prophylaxis study terminated after that cross-study decision; it did not fail a survival primary endpoint. These are distinct trial outcomes within one indication-level program.

GPNMB-directed antibody-drug conjugate. PrECOG 0504 was registered as phase 1/2 but only the phase 1 dose-finding portion enrolled; the planned phase 2 portion was not undertaken after the company discontinued development for this indication. This is not classified as an efficacy endpoint failure.

Single primary protein target remains unresolved. NCT02730884 terminated at investigator request due to low accrual with three enrolled; this is a recruitment event and not evidence of lack of efficacy.

indication_name: relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors
notes: Single primary clinical mechanism is unresolved. NCT01055067 stopped for futility under its prespecified Simon two-stage rule; this is an indication-specific event and does not establish MET target failure.

IL-6 binding mechanism confirmed by approved product information SRC-FDA-siltuximab-label. NCT01266811 was a planned phase 3 study withdrawn before enrollment based on another study; it is not evidence of endpoint failure in this trial. Program remains under review for broader myeloma development.

Two separate phase 2 protocols are distinguished. Completed NCT00513071 found zero qualifying PSA responses among 28 patients. Later NCT01267266 stopped after only eight of 31 treated patients reached randomization following a saracatinib lead-in; its planned randomized efficacy comparison was not adequately tested. Saracatinib inhibits Fyn and other Src-family kinases without one established primary protein assignment; neither trial is a single-protein target-failure demonstration.

Balovaptan selectively antagonizes the V1a receptor (AVPR1A). VANILLA phase 2 in adult men missed its SRS-2 primary endpoint despite a favorable Vineland-II secondary signal. Pediatric aV1ation phase 2 and adult V1aduct phase 3 did not improve their Vineland-II two-domain primary endpoints versus placebo; V1aduct stopped after interim futility. The linked phase 3 record includes an open-label extension but is not an extension-only trial. These are indication- and population-specific outcomes, not proof that AVPR1A is biologically invalid.

indication_name: coronary heart disease and acute coronary syndrome
notes: Darapladib selectively inhibits lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 encoded by PLA2G7. Completed STABILITY and SOLID-TIMI 52 phase 3 trials did not improve their respective primary cardiovascular outcomes; the separate Mayo endothelial-function trial was also negative. The target is not the secretory PLA2 family inhibited by varespladib.

indication_name: previously treated advanced non-small-cell lung cancer
notes: NCT03228186 reported objective responses in a single-arm phase 2 study; its registry says the trial stopped because the pharmaceutical company discontinued the study drug. The observed response rate is not an efficacy-endpoint failure and the registry does not establish why the company made its broader drug decision. Pevonedistat inhibits the NEDD8-activating enzyme complex; no unique primary protein is assigned here.

NCT03319537 is a separate phase 1/2 mesothelioma study with efficacy and dose-finding cohorts; it must not be attributed to the lung-cancer program. Registry termination reason is sponsor termination of the study agreement; an efficacy-endpoint failure is not established.

The completed U.S. Act-Earli-AD phase 3 trial NCT00105547 found no benefit on either co-primary cognition or activities-of-daily-living outcome. Myriad then discontinued Flurizan development; the separate global phase 3 NCT00322036 and open-label safety extension NCT00380276 were terminated after that portfolio decision and must not be counted as independent failed efficacy trials. Tarenflurbil was developed as an amyloid-beta-42-lowering gamma-secretase modulator but a unique directly engaged primary protein remains unresolved; this is not a PSEN1-specific target failure.

The early NCT00948259 trial primarily evaluated safety and tolerability. The separate ARGO phase 2 NCT01350362 study did not show significant clinical efficacy. Biochemical studies document GSK3B and GSK3A inhibition but do not establish a unique primary protein mediating the clinical effect.

The phase 2/3 REACH CDM trial NCT03692312 completed. Its registered primary CDM1-RS comparison did not reach conventional statistical significance (p=0.0514) while some secondary outcomes favored tideglusib. Biochemical studies document GSK3B and GSK3A inhibition but do not establish a unique clinical primary protein. Do not infer that the entire development program was discontinued from this result alone.

indication_name: coronary artery disease and acute coronary syndrome
notes: PLASMA and FRANCIS-ACS reported favorable prespecified biomarker outcomes but did not establish fewer clinical cardiovascular events. Later VISTA-16 stopped for futility and possible harm with higher myocardial infarction risk. Varespladib inhibits several secretory phospholipase A2 isoforms; no unique primary protein is assigned and this is not a PLA2G7 failure. The separate intravenous sickle-cell NCT01522196 protocol is recorded under its own indication-level program.

indication_name: sickle cell disease with vaso-occlusive crisis
notes: IMPACTS-2/NCT01522196 studied prevention of acute chest syndrome with intravenous varespladib and enrolled two participants. The registry says the study terminated because of a change in company plans; it does not establish an efficacy-endpoint failure or explicitly attribute this decision to VISTA-16.
GRADUATE I and II; antibody binds aggregated amyloid beta represented by the APP target row; trial status and endpoint result are separate fields.
MISSION AD1 and AD2; Eisai and Biogen discontinued development after an unfavorable benefit-risk review.

indication_name: asymptomatic amyloid-positive and early Alzheimer disease
notes: EARLY phase 2b/3 and its phase 2 long-term extension; dosing stopped in May 2018 after liver-enzyme elevations changed the sponsor's benefit-risk assessment. Do not interpret post-termination efficacy analyses as the original stopping rationale.

LUSTER-1 and LUSTER-2 tested exacerbations in severe asthma; ZEAL-1 and ZEAL-2 tested lung function in less severe uncontrolled asthma. All four phase 3 trials completed without meeting their respective efficacy endpoints; Novartis stopped further asthma development.

indication_name: geographic atrophy due to age-related macular degeneration
notes: CHROMA and SPECTRI phase 3 trials; intravitreal anti-complement factor D Fab did not reduce geographic atrophy enlargement versus sham in the week-48 primary analysis.

Completed phase 3 osteoarthritis studies included efficacy signals and joint safety concerns. Pfizer and Lilly discontinued global development in October 2021 after an FDA Complete Response Letter and negative EMA CHMP opinion; do not label the representative trials as endpoint failures.

indication_name: moderately to severely active systemic lupus erythematosus
notes: EMBODY 1 and EMBODY 2 completed phase 3 trials; neither achieved a statistically significant week-48 BICLA primary endpoint versus placebo. Earlier ALLEVIATE supply interruption is not conflated with these efficacy results.

indication_name: moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
notes: SIRROUND-D and SIRROUND-T completed phase 3 trials with positive efficacy results. A subsequent FDA Complete Response Letter sought additional safety data; Janssen then did not pursue global RA approvals and withdrew its EMA application. This is not an efficacy-endpoint failure.

SYNERGY completed phase 2 with a negative primary endpoint; development continued into AFFINITY. AFFINITY Part 1 then missed its primary and key secondary endpoints; the registry marks the combined Part 1/2 protocol terminated because Part 2 was discontinued. Biogen discontinued opicinumab development in October 2020; registry states the Part 2 stop was not based on safety concerns.

The phase 2 SPARK trial tested anti-alpha-synuclein antibody cinpanemab. Registry status is terminated following negative year-1 primary and secondary outcomes; the primary publication reports no clinical or DaT-SPECT benefit and a lack-of-efficacy stop after interim review. Biogen separately reported program discontinuation in February 2021.

PASSPORT tested anti-N-terminal-tau antibody gosuranemab and did not meet its week-52 PSP Rating Scale primary endpoint. The registry labels the study terminated after that result and states there were no safety concerns. Biogen stopped development for PSP and other primary tauopathies but continued the separate TANGO Alzheimer disease study at that time; do not present this as an all-indication stop.

indication_name: advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
notes: GAMMA-1 evaluated anti-MMP9 andecaliximab added to mFOLFOX6 as first-line therapy. The phase 3 protocol completed; the primary overall-survival endpoint was not improved versus placebo plus mFOLFOX6. A response-rate signal did not translate into an overall-survival benefit.

TANGO is a separate indication-specific program from PASSPORT. Its protocol lists safety as the primary objective; the prespecified week-78 CDR-SB efficacy endpoint was not met and the registry says the study was terminated after lack of efficacy following the placebo-controlled readout. Do not imply the primary safety endpoint failed.

The anti-tau phase 2 PSP study was terminated after prespecified interim futility criteria were met. The primary publication found no week-52 PSP Rating Scale benefit versus placebo. The clinical trial stop is attributed to lack of efficacy rather than a safety finding.

The RAINIER phase 2 trial tested an anti-LOXL2 antibody and was terminated when the second interim analysis met prespecified futility criteria. The primary publication found no improvement in progression-free survival

MINDSET was a completed phase 3 trial of the HTR6 antagonist intepirdine added to donepezil. The primary publication found no benefit on either co-primary ADAS-Cog or ADCS-ADL endpoint over 24 weeks. Registry completion is not itself the endpoint outcome.
